session-logs.note: Where the record of a finished interview session can be found. Point this at wherever your interviewer leaves its output, or leave it unset and hand over a file each time. Change it when you switch to a different interviewer.

interview-method.note: How the user is questioned when a package is prepared. Any interview or elicitation method available in the environment can answer this source. Prefer one this skill can invoke directly; a method only a person can start still works, it is just handed over rather than driven. Leave it unset to be offered what is available, or set it to built-in to use the method the plugin ships.
